about: Base map of Lisbon and its approaches (the flights frames' wide area) for the flights map: land, coast, rivers, urban areas, district lines and place labels, clipped from Natural Earth 1:10m
label: fact (a public-domain map)
method: polygons clipped to the box (Sutherland-Hodgman), lines kept as runs inside the box plus one point either side; simplified (Douglas-Peucker, about 100 to 200 m); coordinates rounded to 4 decimals (about 10 m)
